name: Wailing Caverns: the Disciple of Naralex still starts Mutanus in Pit of Fangs (#8037)
contract: Decision on #8037: the Disciple of Naralex 3678 offers 'Let the event begin!' (gossip menu 201) in Dreamer's
Rock, full runs and Pit of Fangs, but not in a wing whose final boss is not Mutanus 3654. Pit of Fangs
(LFGDungeons 1003) is a decided exception, so a Dungeon Finder group assigned it keeps the option.

steps.label: SETUP: the hero is in Wailing Caverns
the group is assigned Wailing Caverns - Pit of Fangs
the hero opens the Disciple's gossip
Pit of Fangs keeps the Mutanus event
